title: Full Stack Developer
description: Build responsive web applications, APIs, and client dashboards using modern frontend and backend practices.
requirements: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or similar frontend frameworks
Backend skills in PHP / Node.js with REST API design experience
Basic database knowledge: MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB
Understanding of Git workflow, deployment processes, and staging environments

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description: Plan SEO, social, and paid campaign activities for IT, education, and service-sector clients.
requirements: Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign management
Practical SEO knowledge — keyword research, on-page, and link building
Ability to create and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook
Comfort with analytics tools: Google Analytics, Search Console, Meta Insights
nice_to_have: Basic graphic design or Canva skills
